purpose: Mandatory fixed physical model for3D source-solver inversion acceptance; use exact bundled arrays, not a task-selected synthetic model. Not a solver adapter or universal numerical kernel configuration.

model_identity.initialization: Use bundled initial verbatim. Never reblur or start from an existing inverted checkpoint for a fresh test.
forbidden_silent_changes: recompute from raw data using different preprocessing
model_identity.only_explicit_user_override: A later explicit user choice may define a separately labelled case; task/agent/resource convenience cannot replace this mandatory profile.

reference_waveform.normalization: Exact negative-central second derivative of Gaussian from the native reference, not a unit-peak Ricker. The numeric coefficient1e10 multiplies this waveform; native units/signs must be derived/qualified.

acquisition.binding_contract: Preserve declared physical grids; native coordinate frames, vector components and units need an explicit qualified map. Native class names/ZRT/SPZ labels are reference provenance, not a mandatory software API. Unsupported physics/observables must be disclosed as a scoped variant, never hidden by changing the model.

objective.name: Debiased soft-DTW divergence
objective.ground_cost: Exact squared fixed-scale normalized amplitude difference
objective.scale: Fixed positive original-record observed RMS per shot over all declared times/receivers/components
objective.trace_normalization: Each divergence / processed_Nt, mean over all declared scalar traces, then mean over all9 independent shots
objective.sampling_contract: Bind actual native timing/observations explicitly. Any required native-to-declared sampling or component map stays in prediction AD and is checked end to end. Different native integration steps are permitted; do not copy a different model or time settings blindly.

inversion.optimizer_state: Empty for a fresh application. Only an explicit continuation resumes the full actual checkpoint.
inversion.native_and_optimizer_choices: Native mesh/order/modes/integrator/precision/history/MPI, qualified model-map VJP and optimizer are solver-specific. Measure resource/step affordability without altering fixed material arrays. Current reference safeguarded physical trials100m/s initial/500m/s cap are a disclosed reference, not an imposed optimizer API.

presentation.color_scale: Joint minimum and maximum of true, initial and last accepted Vp within the complete native coverage, before extracting sections.
presentation.coverage: Use the actual declared native-coverage mask consistently for all columns. Preserve full control extents and disclose unsimulated padding; do not pick favourable crops. Current reference cylinder and raw footprint are recorded below.

data_provenance.dataset: SEG/EAGE 3-D Salt and Overthrust, Saltf@@ volume

coarse_preparation.truth: Gaussian anti-alias sigma(z,y,x)=(8,20,20) raw cells = (160,400,400)m, nearest boundaries; trilinear sample to17x17x9 after centering rawx/y at6750m, nearest outer extension
coarse_preparation.initial: Gaussian filter of coarse true Vp, sigma=(1.8,1.8,1.8) coarsecells, physicalsigma=(2250,2250,940.5)m,mode nearest,order0,truncate4

data_provenance.refinement: Exact nested trilinear prolongation17x17x9 to33x33x17; no new geological detail and no re-filtering; coarse nodes preserved bitwise

reference_geometry.outer_material_extension: Nearest raw-boundary material outside the original square; supplied field values are authoritative.
reference_geometry.display: Historical AxiSEM3D geometry record only; presentation.sections_m is normative: x=0,y=0,depth=2090m for matching XZ/YZ/XY views.

native_realization_boundary.mandatory: Exact material arrays/initial/axes/fixed priors and full non-axisymmetric variation. Preserve the supplied original raw footprint and control extent.
native_realization_boundary.allowed: Derive the solver-specific interpolation/coordinate map and its consistent transpose onto its own native realization. Extra numerical padding may be declared without changing supplied samples.
native_realization_boundary.unsupported: If the input cannot realize this full3D physical model, report that limitation; do not substitute easier geology or call an altered case this acceptance profile.
native_realization_boundary.reference_only: The existing AxiSEM3D cylindrical/free-edge/NEWMARK/oddNr/P2 realization is provenance, not a requirement for every high-performance3D forward solver.
